meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求审查已完成的工作时,Claude 会先收集目标、约束、变更文件等信息,再并行启动 5 个后台子代理,核查目标、代码质量、安全性等,并实际运行应用、挖掘相关上下文;全部通过才算通过。
howto.when: 在提交 PR 前,或你说“review work”“check my work”“QA my work”等短语,或明确要求审查已完成工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我 review 一下这次改动的代码
say.note: 会并行启动 5 个子代理审查,全部通过才算通过

say.text: 把最近的改动 QA 一遍,确认能跑起来
say.note: QA 子代理会实际运行应用做测试

say.text: 检查我的改动有没有实现原需求
say.note: 目标核查子代理会逐条比对需求和实现

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gathers goal, constraints, changed files, then launches 5 parallel sub-agents: goal fit, code quality, security, QA, context mining (GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered before a PR handoff, or when you explicitly ask to review completed work, e.g. 'review work', 'check my work', 'QA my work', etc.

say_en.text: Review the code I just changed.
say_en.note: Launches 5 parallel sub-agents; all must pass.

say_en.text: QA my recent changes and confirm they run.
say_en.note: The QA sub-agent actually runs the app.

say_en.text: Check if my changes meet the original requirements.
say_en.note: Goal sub-agent compares requirements vs implementation.
